origin: A window of a real Codex CLI rollout spanning a context compaction, plus its session_meta. Redacted by field allowlist: the compacted event's payload carries the conversation it replaced and only the fact that it happened is kept. The cumulative token counters are rebased by subtracting the window's opening totals -- every per-turn delta, which is the only thing counted, is unchanged, and without it a mid-session window would open with a 10-million-token first turn that no session ever had.
method: Counted from the raw JSONL by a second implementation written against the rollout's shape, never calling internal/parser.

derivations.records: 4 token_count events, of which 2 advance the counters. The two that do not are the window's opening baseline and the event Codex writes immediately after compacting, which restates the same totals -- a turn that spent nothing is not a turn.
derivations.input_tokens: the two advancing turns' input deltas with the cached share taken out: (16,368-9,984) + (19,555-9,984) = 15,955.
derivations.cache_read_tokens: 9,984 + 9,984, each clamped to the input delta it is part of.
derivations.reasoning_tokens: 9 + 39, a part of output rather than an addition to it.
derivations.cache_write_tokens: Codex publishes no cache-write counter, and its depth row no longer claims the signal.
derivations.cache_write_1h_tokens: no cache write, so no tier of one.
derivations.rework_lines: the only file activity is a creation, so there is nothing yet to undo.
derivations.tool_calls: the same applied file change; Codex records a patch application rather than an edit-tool call.
derivations.rejected: Codex does not record tool-use denials.
derivations.tool_errors: Codex marks failures only for file edits, which its depth row excludes.
derivations.compactions: one top-level event of type 'compacted'. Unlike Claude Code, Codex writes a single line for the overflow, so the count is the count of lines here -- the two sources differ, which is why the number is adjudicated per source rather than assumed.
derivations.skipped: every line is valid JSON and every shape is one the parser knows.
